## Atlas submission

- [ ] I started from `atlas/submissions/template.json`.
- [ ] The record contains exact coordinates and complete provenance.
- [ ] `npm run atlas:submission -- path/to/record.json` passes.
- [ ] I included a seed and solver/construction version.
- [ ] I understand that proof and citation claims require human review.

### What changes?

Describe the problem slice, previous best-known record, new utilization, and construction.

### Evidence

Link primary literature where applicable. Do not label a result proven unless the proof is included and reviewable.
